design.name: Palace of Lights
design.description: Six palace-window celebrations, an illustrated venue map, a baraat procession and interactive fireworks.
design.interaction: Include palace fireworks and the baraat

html:
Dear Your Family,

A royal invitation awaits you

The wedding of

Aarav & Meher

25 – 28 · 11 · 2027

Best with sound on

Dear Your Family,

The Khanna & Bhatia families invite you to the wedding of

Aarav&Meher

25 – 28 · 11 · 2027 · UDAIPUR

✦ Tap the sky for fireworks

Four days at the

Palace of Lights

SCROLL

Shri Ganeshaya Namah

With the blessings of

Smt. Kamla & Shri Raghunath Khanna
Smt. Pushpa & Shri Mohan Bhatia

Mr. Rajiv & Mrs. Anjali Khanna

request the pleasure of your company at the wedding celebrations of their son

Aarav

with

Meher

daughter of Mr. Sanjay & Mrs. Ritu Bhatia

Thursday 25 to Sunday 28 November 2027The Oberoi Udaivilas · Udaipur

Four days

Six celebrations

Scroll slowly. Each palace window opens on a celebration.

Find your way

The palace map

Tap a golden label

Six celebrations, one palace. Tap a label.

Meet the couple

Aarav & Meher

We met at a friend's wedding in Udaipur, argued about the best kachori in the city, and have been arguing happily ever since. Four days, six celebrations and all our favourite people in one palace. Come dance with us.

Aarav & Meher

RSVP

Will you join us?

Kindly reply by 25 October 2027, so we can plan your stay and travel.

Will you attend?
Which celebrations?
Number of guests
2
Arriving on
Do you need a room?

Please add your name so the family knows who replied.

Your reply goes directly to the hosts through WhatsApp.

Good to know

Things to know

A few little details, so you can simply enjoy the four days.

Weather

Late November in Udaipur means warm, sunny days and cool evenings. Pack a light shawl.

Your stay

Rooms are held for our guests from 24 to 29 November. Tell us in your RSVP.

Getting here

Shuttles run from Udaipur airport and the city on all four days. Valet at the palace.

Dress codes

Every celebration has its own colours. Look for the swatches under each window.

Your photos

Share every moment with #AaravWedsMeher, so we can relive it through your eyes.

Gifts

Your presence is our present. Your blessings are all we wish for.

Saturday · 27 November · 6 PM

Here comes the baraat!

Scroll to bring the groom to the palace

Tap the sky to celebrate

See you at the palace

Counting down to the Mehendi

376DAYS
15HOURS
10MINUTES
06SECONDS

With love

The Khanna & Bhatia families

#AaravWedsMeher
